mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memory_event (id, tenant_id, owner_id, session_id, agent_id, agent_role, event_type, event_key, role, content, structured_payload, source_type, trust_level, source_message_id, created_at) VALUES (CAST(#{id} AS uuid), #{tenantId}, #{ownerId}, CAST(#{sessionId} AS uuid), CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid)NULL, #{agentRole}, #{eventType}, #{eventKey}, #{role}, #{content}, CAST(#{structuredPayload} AS jsonb), #{sourceType}, #{trustLevel}, CAST(#{sourceMessageId} AS uuid)NULL, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (source_message_id, event_type, event_key) WHERE source_message_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, owner_id, session_id, agent_id, agent_role, event_type, event_key, role, content, structured_payload::text AS structured_payload, source_type, trust_level, source_message_id, sequence_no, created_at FROM memory_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY sequence_no DESC LIMIT #{limit}
